summary: Recorded the remaining branch of the follower restore guard in the snapshot-restore account. raft.restore first rejects a snapshot whose index does not exceed the committed index, then applies its local-role guards, and when the local log already matches the snapshot index and term it commits to that index and returns false without invoking log.restore or restoreRemotes, so the role maps stay as the log's own entries define them; otherwise the log is restored and restoreRemotes later rebuilds the remote, observer and witness maps. Both exercised deliveries took other branches, so this one is source-only and the new limitation says so. Added a sourced behavior entry, an explicit knowledge use and the limitation. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with a knowledge create and an interpretation append changing knowledge and limitations. No execution was run.
